title: NetworkProjectMemberResult
description: network.project-member-result@1: OpenVibe.Network's answer to GET /internal/projects/:project_id/members/:subject (network.project.member.read). It says whether one person belongs to a developer project, with which role, and whether the project is archived, so a receiver can check a project delegation (ADR-003 amendment 2026-10-12: the person must be an admin or owner of an unarchived project). Only members are answered; a non-member and an unknown project are both 404 project.member_not_found. It carries no other members, no apps and no secrets.
